fpga_platform.label: Generic / unspecified
fpga_platform.notes: Used when an implementation targets an FPGA toolchain or netlist without one specific board.

fpga_platform.label: MiST
fpga_platform.notes: Altera Cyclone III board; MiSTer's predecessor, still targeted by some Amiga/Atari ST-oriented cores.

fpga_platform.label: MiSTer FPGA
fpga_platform.notes: Terasic DE10-Nano (Cyclone V) based open hardware platform; the most widely targeted platform for open-source arcade and console FPGA cores.

fpga_platform.label: Neptuno
fpga_platform.notes: Low-cost Cyclone IV board popular for ZX Spectrum and other 8-bit computer cores.

fpga_platform.label: Other
fpga_platform.notes: A named platform not yet covered by this table; add a row rather than overload this one.

fpga_platform.label: Analogue Pocket
fpga_platform.notes: Handheld device (Xilinx Artix-7) running user-loadable 'openFPGA' cores, a separate core ecosystem from MiSTer.

fpga_platform.label: ReplayFPGA
fpga_platform.notes: Xilinx Spartan-6 board from the Replay project, an early FPGA reimplementation platform that predates MiSTer.
